after3_start.name: Me
after3_start.text: *After school. The aftermath of lunch lingers. — Still, I have to go somewhere.*

after3_seo_1.name: Me
after3_seo_1.text: *I opened the student council room door. — 서연(Seoyeon) is slumped over the desk.*

after3_seo_2.name: Me
after3_seo_2.text: *I’ve never seen this before. The perfect student council president — collapsed defenseless over her desk.*

after3_seo_3.name: Me
after3_seo_3.text: *서연(Seoyeon) lifts her head at the sound of someone entering. Her eyes look tired. Her makeup is slightly smudged.*

after3_seo_8.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_seo_8.text: This side of me. — This is a secret.

after3_seo_9.name: Me
after3_seo_9.text: *서연(Seoyeon) straightens her posture. But — her usual perfect smile doesn’t return.*

after3_seo_choice.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_seo_choice.text: Next time I ask you for a favor, you have to say yes. No questions asked. — Consider it payment.
choices: You don’t have to be perfect, you know

after3_seo_choice1.name: Me
after3_seo_choice1.text: *서연(Seoyeon) pauses. Her lips tremble. — Then she smiles. An unpracticed smile.*

after3_seo_choice1_react.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_seo_choice1_react.text: ...Words like that. You shouldn’t say them so easily.

after3_seo_choice2.name: Me
after3_seo_choice2.text: *Her eyes are glistening. — She didn’t cry. Not yet.*

after3_seo_end.name: Me
after3_seo_end.text: *Those words carry weight. — I think I’m starting to understand how monumental it is for this person to show an imperfect side of herself.*

after3_yuna_1.name: Me
after3_yuna_1.text: *The library annex. 유나(Yuna)’s secret reading nook. — The door is open.*

after3_yuna_2.name: Me
after3_yuna_2.text: *I go in, but 유나(Yuna) isn’t here. Instead — a notebook lies open on the sofa. Filled with handwriting.*

after3_yuna_3.name: Me
after3_yuna_3.text: *It’s a novel. A novel 유나(Yuna) wrote. — Is it okay to read?*

after3_yuna_5.name: Me
after3_yuna_5.text: *’One day, a transfer student arrived. He came to the library and sat down next to me without a word. — I didn’t mind it.’*

after3_yuna_7.name: Me
after3_yuna_7.text: *유나(Yuna)’s voice from behind. I turn around and she’s standing there holding two drinks. — She freezes when she sees me looking at the notebook.*

after3_yuna_9.name: Me
after3_yuna_9.text: *Her ears. Red. — It’s the first time I’ve seen 유나(Yuna) blush.*

after3_yuna_choice.name: {name}
choices: You might want to change the protagonist’s name though

after3_yuna_choice1_2.name: {name}
after3_yuna_choice1_2.text: ’A transfer student came to the library’ is just a coincidence?

after3_yuna_choice1_react.name: Me
after3_yuna_choice1_react.text: *She said fiction, but her ears are lying.*

after3_yuna_choice2.name: Me
after3_yuna_choice2.text: *유나(Yuna) pauses. She looks down at the notebook.*

after3_yuna_choice2_2.name: 유나(Yuna)
after3_yuna_choice2_2.text: ...I haven’t decided on the ending yet.

after3_yuna_choice2_3.name: 유나(Yuna)
after3_yuna_choice2_3.text: ...Because once I write the ending, it’s over.

after3_yuna_choice2_react.name: Me
after3_yuna_choice2_react.text: *유나(Yuna) spoke more than two sentences in a row. — For her, that’s proof of emotion.*

after3_yuna_end.name: Me
after3_yuna_end.text: *유나(Yuna) clutches the notebook tightly to her chest.*

after3_dain_1.name: Me
after3_dain_1.text: *The gym. 다인(Dain) is stretching alone. She tries a light jog and —*

after3_dain_2.name: Me
after3_dain_2.text: *— slightly tweaks her right leg. She winces.*

after3_dain_4.name: 다인(Dain)
after3_dain_4.text: Ah! I’m fine!! It’s just a little twist!!

after3_dain_6.name: Me
after3_dain_6.text: *Too many exclamation marks. — Way too many. Does this girl use more exclamation marks when she’s not okay?*

after3_dain_choice.name: Me
after3_dain_choice.text: *다인(Dain) sits on the bench. She rubs her knee.*
choices: Sit next to her and wait quietly
Got any patches? I’ll go get them

after3_dain_choice1.name: Me
after3_dain_choice1.text: *I sit beside her without a word. 다인(Dain) glances my way.*

after3_dain_choice1_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1_3.text: Because you’d just say you’re fine.

after3_dain_choice1_react.name: Me
after3_dain_choice1_react.text: *다인(Dain) freezes. — Then smiles softly. A smile without exclamation marks.*

after3_dain_choice2.name: Me
after3_dain_choice2.text: *A quiet 다인(Dain). — I think I’m feeling her real temperature for the first time.*

after3_dain_end.name: Me
after3_dain_end.text: *다인(Dain) lightly punches my shoulder with her fist. — Weaker than yesterday.*

after3_confront_1.name: Me
after3_confront_1.text: *Coming out of the after-school spot — 서연(Seoyeon) is waiting in the hallway. Arms crossed. Her usual composure is gone.*

after3_confront_3.name: Me
after3_confront_3.text: *서연(Seoyeon) leads me to the end of the hallway. Where no one else is.*

after3_confront_5.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_confront_5.text: When you smile at the other girls, something inside me crumbles.

after3_confront_6.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_confront_6.text: Be honest. Did you promise all of us the weekend?

after3_confront_choice.name: Me
after3_confront_choice.text: *서연(Seoyeon) looks straight at me. Not with the eyes of a student council president. With the eyes of just a person.*
choices: The time slots are different, so I thought it would be fine
You’re the only one I’m serious about

after3_confront_admit_2.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_confront_admit_2.text: That’s the cruelest thing you can say, {name}. Kindness that can’t refuse — gives people false hope.

after3_confront_admit_3.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_confront_admit_3.text: I don’t want to be one of your options.

after3_confront_admit_4.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_confront_admit_4.text: Either the only answer, or nothing at all. — I can’t do halfway.

after3_confront_admit_5.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_confront_admit_5.text: ...I won’t be leaving the rooftop open today.

after3_confront_admit_6.name: Me
after3_confront_admit_6.text: *Her back is straight. Perfectly. — But her shoulders are trembling.*

after3_confront_excuse.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_confront_excuse.text: ...You don’t see how that’s the problem?

after3_confront_excuse_2.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after3_confront_excuse_2.text: It’s not about the number of promises. It’s about the weight of them.

after3_confront_lie_2.name: Me
after3_confront_lie_2.text: *Eyes that want to believe. — I didn’t know a lie could weigh this much.*

after3_confront_yuna_enter.name: Me
after3_confront_yuna_enter.text: *After 서연(Seoyeon) leaves — 유나(Yuna) is standing at the end of the hallway. I don’t know how long she’s been there.*

after3_confront_yuna_4.name: 유나(Yuna)
after3_confront_yuna_4.text: I just want you to understand the weight of choosing whose side you’ll stand on.

after3_confront_yuna_5.name: 유나(Yuna)
after3_confront_yuna_5.text: Don’t run away tomorrow. Take responsibility for the hopes you created.

after3_confront_yuna_6.name: Me
after3_confront_yuna_6.text: *유나(Yuna) spoke in long sentences. Multiple sentences. — That means she’s that angry.*

after3_final.name: Me
after3_final.text: *After school is over. — What I saw today won’t leave my mind.*

after3_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_freetalk.text: *Standing face to face with Seoyeon in the hallway. Her expression is complicated.*
after3_seo_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, right after confrontation/reconciliation with Seoyeon. Trust is shaken.
after3_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool student council president. Strong possessiveness, direct when jealous. Hurt but trying not to show it.

after3_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_freetalk.text: *Walking alongside Yuna. Her gaze is cool.*
after3_yuna_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, just talked with Yuna. She's showing more emotion than usual.
after3_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Usually calm but emotionally shaken now. More about wanting confirmation than jealousy.

after3_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after3_dain_freetalk.text: *Sitting on a bench with Dain at the playground. She's quieter than usual.*
after3_dain_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, just talked with Dain. She's hurt but pretending to be cheerful.
after3_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. Being cheerful is her only defense. Fewer exclamation marks mean she's being real.
